name: DCA Aunt Cass Café Roasted Turkey Sandwich on Fresh Boudin Sourdough (No Pesto/Tomato Mod)
brandOrRestaurant: Aunt Cass Café (San Fransokyo Square · Disney California Adventure)
whyItWorks: Slices of oven-roasted turkey breast, bacon, and Havarti/provolone cheese on fresh-baked Boudin sourdough bread make one of the cleanest lunches in California Adventure.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Turkey Club on Sourdough (or the Kids' Turkey Sandwich on Sourdough) and ask for no pesto mayo, no raw tomato, and no shredded lettuce.
watchOuts: Standard adult sandwich includes garlic basil pesto aioli—request plain or order the Kids' Turkey Sandwich on Sourdough
